sender.en: A loan company page on social media

name.en: Instant loan offered online, but only after you send a deposit

how.en: A social media page offers quick loans, sometimes copying the name of a real Belizean lender. To release the loan you must first transfer a deposit or fee into an account. Once you pay, the loan never comes and the page asks for more or disappears. The Central Bank of Belize regularly warns about lenders that are not licensed to do moneylending business in Belize.

text.en: A social media page or message offers a fast loan with easy approval.
The page uses the name of a real Belizean business or looks like a licensed lender.
Before the loan is released, you are told to send a deposit or processing fee to an account.
After you pay, there is no loan, only new fees or silence.

QUICK CASH BZ ✅ Loans BZ$1,000 to BZ$15,000 approved same day, no job letter needed. Just send the $100 security deposit to the account we give you and the funds go to your account in 2 hrs. Inbox us now!
